artworks.title: General Joseph Hooker
artworks.description: The image shows a male figure seated on a foldable wooden chair in a side-profile position, wearing a full military uniform. He has sharp facial features, light hair, and a composed expression. He is wearing polished boots, and a sword with a decorative hilt is beside him. A draped flag with stars is hanging on his right. There is a textured carpet beneath his feet, and the background is a plain wall.

artworks.title: General George Armstrong Custer
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up, seated and slightly turned to the side. He has prominent facial features with a strong jawline and a mustache. His hair is long and wavy, extending past his shoulders. He is wearing a dark military uniform with buttons and a light necktie. On his shoulders, he has insignias. He is also wearing a wide-brimmed hat with a pin on the front. The background is a neutral tone.

artworks.title: General Ulysses S. Grant
artworks.description: The image depicts a man in a formal military uniform with a high rank. He has a full beard and mustache, styled hair, and is seated with one arm resting on a surface and the other on the chair's arm. The background is plain with a slight sepia tone, indicating a studio setting.

artworks.title: General William Tecumseh Sherman
artworks.description: The image depicts a man's upper body in a three-quarters view. The man is seated with his arms crossed over his chest and facing slightly to the right. He has a stern expression with distinct facial features, including a prominent brow, deep-set eyes, and a full beard that is dark with lighter patches. His hair is short and slightly tousled. He wears a military uniform with a stiff collar, epaulettes on his shoulders, buttons, and rank insignias. The background is plain and neutral.

artworks.title: General Abram Duryée
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a man's body, from just above the waist. The man is seated and positioned slightly at an angle, with his body turned to the left while his face looks directly at the camera. He has distinct facial features including a prominent forehead, deep-set eyes, and noticeable sideburns that extend almost from his curly dark hair. He is wearing a formal dark uniform adorned with multiple rows of shiny buttons and a visible rank insignia on his shoulder. The plain, neutral-toned background emphasizes the subject.

artworks.title: General Arnold Elzey
artworks.description: The image depicts a man seated, facing forward with a serious expression. He has wavy hair, a full beard, and a mustache. He wears a military-style coat with stars on the collar. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Francis E. Brownell
artworks.description: The image depicts a man standing upright and facing the viewer. He is holding a rifle with a bayonet attached, resting it on the ground. The man has a serious expression, a neat mustache, a short beard, and wears a military uniform with a brimmed cap. He stands on a patterned floor against a textured neutral backdrop. Nearby, there is a bundle of fabric or possibly a flag and a small architectural feature partially visible on the right side.

artworks.title: Colonel Frederick D'Utassy
artworks.description: In the image, a man is standing upright, facing to the side, and holding a large flag. He wears a dark military-style uniform with elaborate epaulettes, a row of buttons down the front, and a belt across his chest. He has a hat featuring a cockade and possibly a feather. The man has a beard, mustache, and short hair visible beneath the hat. Beside him is a substantial flag with symbols, text, and intricate fringe detailing. The flag displays various colors and patterns with different designs and letters. The background features a plain wall with decorative molding near the floor. The man stands on a decorative tile floor.

artworks.title: "Part of General Geary's Staff. Taken on Lookout Mountain Summit on Christmas Day."
artworks.description: The image shows a group of six men positioned on rocky ground. Five men are standing, and one man is seated. The man on the far left is standing with a hat on his head, and three mustaches, in a military uniform decorated with buttons. His facial expression is neutral as he looks into the distance. Next to him, a man stands with his legs crossed, with one hand on his hip and the other holding a wide-brimmed hat. He has a mustache and a pointed beard. The two men next to him stand slightly behind a large rock, both wearing military uniforms and hats, with facial hair visible. At their feet, another man is seated on the ground, wearing a uniform with shoulder boards and a few insignias, and his hat is lying next to him. He has medium-length hair and a smooth face, looking slightly to the side. The last man on the right is crouched down, wearing a similar uniform and a military cap, with a full beard and mustache, holding something in his hand. An empty basket and loose fabric are on the ground among the group. The background consists of large, rough rock formations, and some sparse trees are visible.

artworks.title: Captain James Gillette
artworks.description: The image depicts a man facing forward with his head slightly turned to his left. He has wavy hair, light eyes, and a prominent nose. The man wears a dark military-style uniform with shoulder straps and buttons. There are no accessories in the image. The background is plain, and the photograph is framed with the text "Johnston Bros." and "867 Broadway NY" at the bottom.

artworks.title: Frank. Frederick. Alice.
artworks.description: The image shows three children sitting closely together in a row. The child on the left is labeled "Frank" and wears a checkered shirt under overalls. In the center is "Frederick," dressed in a dark buttoned shirt with a white collar. On the right is "Alice," wearing a checkered dress. Each child has a different hairstyle and expression. The backdrop is plain, and the names "Frank," "Frederick," and "Alice" are at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: USS New Hampshire
artworks.description: This is a photograph of the deck of a ship. The image shows the details of a ship's deck, including ropes, pulleys, masts, wooden structures, and gun barrels. The deck appears busy with equipment, and long shadows are cast across it, indicating a sunny day. The photograph offers insight into the complexity and scale of maritime machinery.

artworks.title: John Boyle
artworks.description: The image depicts a man standing in a relaxed pose, with one hand on an ornate chair and the other on his hip. He has a clean-shaven face and styled hair under a round sailor's cap inscribed with "JAMES ADGER". He is wearing a naval outfit with a dark shirt, knotted scarf, and matching trousers. The background includes a patterned curtain and a plain wall, with a diamond-patterned linoleum floor.

artworks.title: Camp Scene
artworks.description: The image shows five men from the waist up, outside a canvas tent, with more tents visible in the background. Two men are standing, while three are seated. The standing man on the left holds a rifle and wears a military cap and a uniform jacket with his hands gloved, while the other standing man is wearing a similar military cap and uniform. The seated men have a more relaxed posture; one is seated in a chair with his hands clasped, another is sitting on a box with his hands resting on his knees, and the third is crouched beside the tent. The men have various facial hair styles, ranging from clean-shaven to having full beards, and they wear military-style caps. Their clothing consists of dark shirts; one man, seated on the right, wears a brimmed hat and suspenders. The background consists of other canvas tents, indicating a campsite setting during the daytime.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman
artworks.description: The image shows a woman from the waist up, seated on the floor, slightly leaning forward. Her facial features are clear, with prominent cheekbones and appearing to have a serious expression. Her hair is parted in the middle and falls neatly on either side of her face. She is wearing a dark, heavy shawl wrapped around her shoulders and a plaid woolen skirt visible beneath. Beside her is a woven basket filled with apples, one of which she holds in her hand. The background is plain, with a neutral-toned wall that suggests an indoor setting, providing a minimal and unobtrusive backdrop to the subject.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman
artworks.description: The image shows a person reclining on a decorative ledge, with one leg bent and the other extended. The individual leans back, supported by their left arm, while the right arm rests on the ledge. The person has short, curly hair styled away from the face and delicate facial features. They wear a polka-dot outfit with white leggings and ankle boots, consisting of a matching vest and skirt, paired with a light-colored blouse and a dark bow tie at the neckline. The surroundings include an intricately carved balustrade and a panel with floral motifs, with a plain and muted background.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Ballet Dancer
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing in a dancer's pose. She is angled slightly away from the camera, with her head turned towards the viewer and her arms crossed in front of her waist. She has a soft expression on her face, styled hair with a floral headpiece, and is wearing a fitted bodice with a voluminous skirt, ballet shoes, and a bracelet on her right wrist. The background consists of a plain wall and a geometric patterned floor.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman
artworks.description: This image shows a woman standing with legs apart and arms lifted, holding dumbbells. She has medium-length dark curly hair and is wearing a dress with puffed sleeves, a checkered skirt, and dark ankle boots. Next to her is a table with a comb or hairbrush and a piece of fabric. The background features a plain wall and patterned floor.

artworks.title: Adelina Patti
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing gracefully. She is positioned with her head slightly tilted and eyes closed. Her right hand is held delicately near her face. She has long, dark, wavy hair falling over her shoulders and down her back. The woman is wearing a voluminous, light-colored dress that extends to the floor, with long, loose sleeves. In her right hand, she holds a candlestick with a lit candle. The background features a rustic setting with a large wooden wheel, stone architecture, and a staircase leading upwards.

artworks.title: Marriage of General Tom Thumb
artworks.description: The image shows four individuals standing during a wedding ceremony. In the center, a man and woman stand facing each other and holding hands. The man wears a dark suit with a white shirt and cravat. The woman is dressed in a light-colored wedding gown with a veil and flowers. To the left of the couple is another man in a dark suit and to the right of the woman is another person in a light dress. An officiant stands behind them holding a book, draped in ecclesiastical vestments. The setting has ornate gothic architectural features, with carved woodwork and a patterned floor carpet.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Clown
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body portrait of a person standing in a three-quarter pose, facing forward with hands placed behind their back. The person's face is painted white with dark, exaggerated features accentuating the eyebrows, lips, and contours of the eyes and mouth. Their head has little to no visible hair. The clothing consists of a polka dot ensemble including a loose-fitting top with ruffled short sleeves and matching shorts with slight ruffles at the hem, paired with striped stockings and pointed shoes. There is no visible jewelry or objects being held by the person. The background features a plain wall with a curtain partially visible on the right side, and the floor has a geometric pattern resembling tiled flooring.

artworks.title: Woman in Costume of Queen of the Night
Portrait of a Woman
artworks.description: The image shows a woman in a standing position. She is facing slightly downward with her hands clasped at her waist. Her hair is styled up, parted in the center. She has defined facial features with a neutral expression. The woman is wearing a long dark dress with a high lace collar, lace detailing down the front, and a white apron tied around her waist. The skirt of her dress seems voluminous, with a striped underskirt showing at the bottom. She is not holding any objects or wearing any jewelry. The background is plain with a uniform tone and a faint line suggesting a division between a wall and floor.

artworks.title: Isabelle "Belle" Freeman
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing upright, facing forward with arms by their sides. The individual has curly, dark hair, wears a tall hat adorned with stars, and is draped in a large fabric resembling an American flag. The attire reveals a light-colored dress or gown, and knee-high lace-up sandals are worn. The background is plain with a slightly textured surface.
